validated_results.title: Socio-economic and lifestyle factors associated with the risk of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort study investigating the association between alcohol consumption and incident prostate cancer risk.

design.excerpt: Using prospective data from a large health screening survey, we examined the association between several lifestyle and socio-economic factors and the development of prostate cancer in a cohort of Norwegian men.

timing.excerpt: Using prospective data from a large health screening survey, we examined the association between several lifestyle and socio-economic factors and the development of prostate cancer in a cohort of Norwegian men.
